sourceRevision: implementation and consumer SHA-256 values recorded in the run manifest
question: Which local image delivery contracts are sufficiently bounded and falsifiable to guide Dolly's endpoint/model-specific multimodal adapter design without relying on owner infrastructure?

proves: OpenAI-compatible request transport to an independently parsing local mock endpoint
bounded local-file inspection and chunk reads
private signed URL fetch, exact signed crop, pinned object version, expiry, and recoverable deletion semantics in a local object-store simulation
endpoint/model capability profiles deterministically select or reject a delivery mode
whether the owner's configured Aether qwen3.6-27b endpoint completes one fixed image-grounded task through the standard OpenAI-compatible inline data URL shape
doesNotProve: semantic image understanding beyond the fixed image, prompt, endpoint/model, and run recorded here
compatibility with any endpoint other than the exact configured Aether endpoint/model observed during this run
Aliyun Object Storage Service behavior or permissions
Dolly product support, because the current chat codec rejects unresolved media references
Module startup safety or runtime service behavior

hypotheses.statement: For a profile that explicitly supports inline PNG input, a canonical base64 data URL transfers exact bytes and all registered size, type, request-size, truncation, and text-only counterexamples are rejected at the registered boundary.
A stat-first, digest-bound, maximum-64-byte chunk reader reconstructs the exact local image while refusing oversized chunks and refusing reads after the file changes.

For a URL-only profile, a version-pinned private signed URL lets the mock model fetch exact full and cropped image bytes, while crop tampering, expiry, omitted version, and a recovered deletion fail closed.
The same local image yields different, deterministic delivery decisions for inline-capable, URL-only, and text-only endpoint/model profiles; no provider name heuristic or public URL is needed.

The exact configured Aether qwen3.6-27b endpoint, with strict SSE, terminal usage, thinking.type=disabled, and no enable_thinking field, completes the fixed image-grounded extraction task in all three repetitions and completes one follow-up calculation grounded in the same image context, while a text-only control does not produce the exact hidden visual values.

baselines.description: A text-only request to the text-only mock profile succeeds, proving the local endpoint is live without implying media support.
At the registered source revision, src/core/model-provider-chat.ts always rejects a validated media part with CHAT_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED before its text-only wire strategy is encoded.

fixtures.generator: sharp 0.35.x from deterministic raw RGB pixels

images.purpose: exceed the per-image byte limit while remaining within the dimension limit
fixed real-model image-grounded extraction and calculation task

media.capabilityEvidence: three exact image-task outcomes, not request acceptance alone

backends.reasoningControl: send thinking.type=disabled, forbid enable_thinking, and require empty reasoning_content for this bounded extraction role
backends.generationWire: stream=true, stream_options.include_usage=true, response_format.type=json_object, temperature=0, 1200 max tokens for extraction and 800 for follow-up
backends.secrets: read AETHER_BASE_URL and AETHER_API_KEY from repository .env at execution time; never write either value, request headers, or response headers
backends.dependencyStatus: optional owner deployment evidence; Dolly must remain functional without it

deliverySelectionRule: Look up the exact endpointId/modelId capability profile; never infer capability from a provider or model name family.
Reject unsupported MIME type, dimensions, item count, per-item bytes, aggregate bytes, and request bytes before dispatch when known.
For local immutable bytes, choose an inline data URL when the exact profile supports it.
Otherwise choose a private version-pinned signed URL only when the exact profile is URL-only and all URL lifecycle requirements are available.
Never choose a public URL in this experiment.
A local chunk reader is a file-inspection tool contract, not a substitute for semantic visual input.

execution.platform: Linux preferred; portable Node.js 20 and sharp APIs only
execution.servers: Two in-process servers bind to 127.0.0.1 on kernel-assigned ports and are closed in finally blocks; no Module or child service is started.
execution.network: Mock cases permit loopback only. The five preregistered real-model calls permit only the exact AETHER_BASE_URL loaded from repository .env; every generation uses stream=true, stream_options.include_usage=true, thinking.type=disabled, a bounded strict SSE parser, one usage event and one DONE marker, with no non-stream fallback. No other non-loopback destination is permitted.
execution.credentials: Real-model calls use AETHER_API_KEY in the Authorization header in memory. Artifacts omit the endpoint, key, request headers, and response headers. OSS and DashScope credentials are never read.
execution.repetitionOrder: case list order, then increasing repetition; no adaptive stopping
execution.rawData: One canonical JSON object per line with expected and observed codes, exact request artifact references, fixture digests, and per-case observations.
execution.independentValidation: A separate Node.js process reparses every mock request, decodes inline bytes, verifies URL signatures and crop/version fields, reconstructs tool chunks, reparses sanitized real-model public content against the fixed answer key, derives registered checks without trusting pass fields, and writes verification.json.

metrics: exact transferred SHA-256 digest, decoded MIME type, width, and height
inline data URL bytes divided by source bytes
chunk count and total encoded chunk bytes
signed URL lifetime, fetch status, pinned version, crop output digest and dimensions

real-model HTTP status, strict SSE event/usage/DONE counts, finish reason, content, reasoning_content presence and length, usage, and exact answer-key fields; never reasoning text, endpoint, authorization, or headers

minimumEffectiveDifference.contractGate: All repetitions of every registered case must independently satisfy its case-specific assertion; one failure blocks that delivery path.
minimumEffectiveDifference.inlineOverhead: Report but do not gate on an inline request/source byte ratio; it is an engineering cost, not evidence of correctness.
minimumEffectiveDifference.modelSemantics: The image arm must pass the exact answer key in 3 of 3 repetitions, the text-only control must not pass the exact hidden answer, and the follow-up must equal 59. Anything weaker does not establish this endpoint/model profile as image-capable.

stoppingRules: Run the fixed matrix once; deterministic success cases have three repetitions and counterexamples have one.
Do not add, remove, or reinterpret cases after seeing results. Any change requires a new preregistration version and fresh artifact directory.
Abort and mark infrastructure-inconclusive if loopback binding, sharp decoding, or artifact writes fail for reasons outside a registered case.
Do not download a model or use more than the already installed dependencies for v0.

Make exactly five strict-streaming Aether chat-completion calls: one text-only control, three identical image-task repetitions, and one follow-up. Do not retry, use a non-stream fallback, or change the prompt after observing a failure. Both RUN_LIVE_INTEGRATION=1 and RUN_PAID_INTEGRATION=1 are required before reading credentials or sending the first call.
decisionRules: Recommend inline base64/local bytes as the default only for exact endpoint/model profiles whose inline path passes every H1 case.
Keep private signed URL as an optional URL-only adapter only if every H3 case passes; otherwise URL-only models remain unsupported.
Recommend a stat-first bounded chunk tool only if every H2 case passes, and label it file inspection rather than vision.
Represent delivery mode, MIME types, limits, post-acceptance fetch behavior, signed lifetime, placement, and response evidence in the endpoint/model profile; never use one global model switch.
Regardless of mock results, current Dolly remains unsupported for chat media until broker resolution, a profile-selected media wire codec, lifecycle cleanup, and real endpoint tests exist.

Mark the exact Aether endpoint/model profile provisionally inline-image-capable only if H5 meets its 3/3 plus control plus follow-up rule; request acceptance or a plausible free-form description is insufficient.
Do not make Dolly depend on Aether, its key, or this model. Treat the result as optional deployment evidence and retain a text-only-capable path.
